authorization: Standing independently inspected matching-material/function/unit disposal-service and complete geographic supply-proxy approvals, applied only to four exact single-fate markets after tracing their sole treatment providers and checking actual wet composition, treatment technology, ash/energy quantities and recovery statements. Source-market delivery differences remain explicit. No new waste grade, disposal fate, helper, allocation reconstruction, omission of caller freight, unit conversion or recovery credit is introduced.

authorization_evidence.authorization: Standing independently inspected matching-material/function/unit disposal and geographic-proxy approvals, applied only after matching the declared wet composition, biogenic-carbon fraction, treatment class, actual cement/residue/facility coordinates and opposite one-kg waste/service reference signs for the enumerated pilot cases. No new waste grade, stabilization process, recovery model, helper or unit conversion is introduced.

Standing independently inspected matching whole-material/function/unit and geographic supply-proxy authorizations, reused only for the exact enumerated pilot water, metal-processing and alloy-stock profiles after checking physical output, service/intermediate boundaries and positive unit references. No new water grade, welding technology, metal-forming stage, blend model, unit conversion, empty stock or recovery credit is introduced. Pending equipment and geothermal decisions remain pending.

limitations: Convert signed waste kg by factor -1 because source waste production is -1kg and native treatment-service production is +1kg. Preserve treatment burdens and credits, lognormal uncertainty, formulas and caller ownership. No absolute-value, density, moisture, heating-value or recovery multiplier is applied.

Use the complete native ordinary municipal-incineration service once, retaining its own ash stabilization, landfill/leachate treatment, allocation and internal logistics. Source markets have a single treatment fate, so no landfill, open-burning, clinker or fly-ash-extraction share is collapsed. Add no new heat, electricity or recovered-metal credit.

Source market collection/delivery freight is not reconstructed by the native incinerator. Native internal transport remains included, and separately listed caller freight is preserved. Market/producer delivery boundaries, country/RoW supply, background energy, infrastructure and vintage differ; quantitative inventory or LCIA equivalence is not established and score effects are unquantified.

Source auxiliary natural-gas heat purchases and native gas-combustion purchases share the inspected numerical MJ coordinates, but their useful-heat versus fuel-input/background boundaries can differ. Retain the complete native service without an efficiency rescaling or separate heat purchase.

Match actual documented wet-composition coordinates and carbon-origin parameters rather than names. Unknown composition entries remain unknown; rounded or inconsistent water labels are not repaired or used as conversion factors. The copper process retains the shared published 60.4% biogenic-carbon parameter without inferring a change from its name.

Native2025 comments are shorter but its positive references and direct technosphere vectors match native2026. Retain native biosphere exclusions. Only enumerated ecoinvent3.9cutoff profiles are approved for this pilot; other versions, changed fates, independent inverse and cross-system-model routes remain unapproved.
